tests: ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when from, to, and limit are 0 calls to get all builds
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when from is specified calls to get all builds from that id
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when from is specified and limit is specified appends limit to the url
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when to is specified calls to get all builds to that id
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when to is specified and limit is specified appends limit to the url
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds when from and to are both specified sends both the from and the to
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds pagination data with a link header returns the pagination data from the header
ATC Handler Jobs JobBuilds without a link header returns pagination data with nil pages
scenarios: Unbounded job build listing returns every persisted build
From cursor returns the exact persisted build suffix
From cursor with limit returns the exact oldest persisted build
To cursor returns the exact persisted build prefix
To cursor with limit returns the exact bounded persisted build
Combined cursors return only the exact persisted range
Bounded job build listing decodes production pagination links
Unbounded job build listing returns empty pagination
